column1: # Device quantities with a LOINC code: one row per code, one column per vendor.
# The vendor cell is the field name as that vendor's documentation prints it
# (type:field where the vendor nests fields); empty means the vendor does not
# produce the quantity, `?` means it does but publishes no field name.
# The metric column is the mirobody catalogue row (res/catalog/metrics.tsv) the code
# belongs to; a confident code there is that metric's identity, an unverified
# one is recorded here and left out of the identity until confirmed.
# Sources, all read 2026-09-09, one per <vendor>.tsv beside this file:
#   apple           Apple HealthKit: https://developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation/healthkit/hkquantitytypeidentifier.json
#   health_connect  Google Health Connect: https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/health/connect/client/records/package-summary
#   huawei          Huawei Health Kit: https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/HMSCore-Guides/overview-0000001177423513
#   honor           Honor Health Kit: https://developer.honor.com/
#   samsung         Samsung Health Data SDK: https://developer.samsung.com/health/data/api-reference
#   fitbit          Fitbit Web API: https://dev.fitbit.com/build/reference/web-api/
#   whoop           WHOOP API v2: https://api.prod.whoop.com/developer/doc/openapi.json
#   oura            Oura API v2: https://cloud.ouraring.com/v2/static/json/openapi-1.37.json
#   garmin          Garmin Health API: https://developer.garmin.com/gc-developer-program/health-api/
#   vivo            vivo BlueOS health API: https://developers-watch.vivo.com.cn/api/health/health/
#   xiaomi          Xiaomi Health cloud: https://dev.mi.com/
#   zepp            Zepp OS Sensor module: https://docs.huami.com/
#   oppo            OPPO theme engine health data: https://open.oppomobile.com/documentation/page/info?id=13624
# Axes were checked against LOINC 2.83. LOINC is copyright Regenstrief
# Institute, Inc. (https://loinc.org/kb/license/); see LICENSE-3RD-PARTY section 3.
# Columns: loinc, name (LOINC long common name, shortened), axes
# (PROPERTY/TIME/SYSTEM/SCALE as printed in the review), metric, confidence
# (confident or unverified), one column per vendor, note.
# The per-vendor files carry the reasoning for each field; the declined fields
# are there too, and the quantities no code fits are in unmappable.tsv.
